hero.description: Launch your branded IPL device without forcing large inventory bets. Start with a small pilot batch, learn fast, then scale with a stable replenishment workflow.

citable.heading: What does “No MOQ” mean for a private-label IPL launch?
citable.body: “No MOQ” means you can start a branded IPL program with a smaller pilot quantity to validate your channel and messaging, then scale production through repeat orders instead of committing to large upfront inventory. A practical No MOQ setup includes clear branding requirements, defined packaging and manual content, stable bill of materials control, and a replenishment plan that supports predictable lead times as volume grows. The goal is to reduce launch risk while preserving a professional brand presentation.

hero.description: Put your brand where customers see it most: on-device, on accessories, and on packaging. We focus on placement, consistency, and durability—not just a logo on a shell.

citable.heading: What is included in logo printing for an IPL private-label project?
citable.body: Logo printing for an IPL private-label project typically includes placement selection, artwork preparation, production method selection (such as silk-screen, pad printing, or laser engraving), and durability verification. A reliable program also defines color targets, alignment tolerances, fixture setup, and batch consistency checks so branding looks consistent across devices, accessories, and packaging. The goal is a premium, durable brand presentation that matches your positioning and reduces return risk due to cosmetic defects.

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.p1: iShine is a professional home-use IPL hair removal device manufacturer based in Guangzhou, China. Since our founding, we have been dedicated to one mission: helping brands bring innovative IPL devices to market.
whoWeAre.p2: We specialize in complete OEM/ODM solutions, offering everything from initial design and prototyping to mass production, packaging, and global logistics. Our team works closely with brand owners, product managers, and designers across different industries to ensure project success.
whoWeAre.p3: With partnerships spanning North America, Europe, and Asia, we've earned trust from leading brands including Costco Canada, ROSESKINCO USA, and KU-2 Cosmetic Germany.
